rationale: Ground truth has no substantive reviewer concerns (bot credit-limit messages and 'thanks'), so both candidates get full recall by default. Both independently converge on the same top-tier finding (new test file lacks pytestmark and is silently deselected by marker-filtered CI) and the sm_110a docstring/code inconsistency, lending credibility to both. X edges ahead with a sharper blocking-severity catch — warmup_quack_fp8() bypasses the new gate entirely, directly undermining the PR's own fix — plus a concrete warning_once dedup bug, both delivered with ready-to-apply code patches. Y's unique ROCm gfx10xx and multi-device-heterogeneity findings are plausible but more speculative/out-of-scope, and its verbose 'Validated' bullet padding dilutes signal-to-noise versus X's tighter, more actionable structure.
